pr_title: doc: make header smaller and dropdown click-driven when JS is on
pr_body:
This PR finishes the work started on https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/41404 by making the header small and the menu click-driver when JS is available on the browser.

Fixes: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/42286
pr_comments:
@Trott Actually I was able to enable linting for that file just by removing it from the ignore list. No issues encountered so far.

@VoltrexMaster Thanks for all your suggestions. It was the same list I got when I eslint-ed the file locally so I did it directly on my working tree.
Any update on this? Is this ready to go?

> The sticky header never shows up on screen smaller than 1000px height, I don't think it's expected, is it?

It was when there was no JS. I've fixed it now. Thanks for noticing.
@aduh95 Are we good to go on this? Can I land it?

issue_context.title: doc: HTML API docs' fixed header obscures anchored content
issue_context.body:
### Version

n/a

### Platform

n/a

### Subsystem

doc

### What steps will reproduce the bug?

Go to the v17.7.0 docs in any section and click one of the links in the list of links at the top of the page. [Example](https://nodejs.org/docs/v17.7.0/api/crypto.html#diffiehellmancomputesecretotherpublickey-inputencoding-outputencoding).

### How often does it reproduce? Is there a required condition?

_No response_

### What is the expected behavior?

The fixed header should not cover/obscure the content I jumped to.

### What do you see instead?

The fixed header covers/obscures the content I jumped to.

### Additional information

I tested this on Firefox (97). For some odd reason Chrome (98) doesn't utilize a fixed header at all.
